name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.132.0 — ADR-0013: the client rehearses the journey. Direct landing of the sweep the record retires: candidate flows (specs/20260908/05) and the grid-in-client-mode draft (specs/20260907/11) are superseded, the dead variants:<j> stop routing is deleted from design-atlas.js and the review page header, ledger add/ask refuse --state so a question pins to a screen and never to a gray state, and the wireframe register moves from the flat zinc no-fills set to shadcn's Neutral component look on the same eleven roles (wire-tokens.css, wire.css, viewer.css value-equal) so a theme is a role re-valuation, never a redraw. 7.131.0 — A test that never finishes is now a bounded red rather than an unbounded hang: the host testCommand and gateCommand both carry --test-timeout=45000 --test-force-exit, and because a second reporter on stdout loses its tail under force-exit, the per-file budget reporter moves to stderr (its __FILE_BUDGET_OK__/__FILE_BUDGET_RED__ contract and exit 1 unchanged). New deterministic /spec:doctor check 18, port-check.js, walks every file under tests/ by location and reports each fixed listen() literal, pid- or random-computed port, and --port <n> flag literal, so the drift spec 06 removed cannot creep back; it is advisory in doctor and pinned green against this repo. 7.130.0 — A missing jq no longer turns the pipeline's stage gates off in silence. All three UserPromptSubmit hooks extract the prompt with jq; without it the extraction yields empty, every gate exits 0, and /spec:plan, /spec:run, /spec:design, /spec:build and /spec:review run unchecked against spec status with the grounding-drift warning off. spec-state-gate.sh now announces that condition on every prompt — naming jq, the install command, and which commands pass unchecked — while staying non-blocking, and genesis-state-gate.sh stays silent so exactly one notice appears per prompt.
